name: 40kdc-pipeline
description: Data pipeline: converts the @alpaca-software/40kdc-data 11th-edition dataset into this game's data formats (army rosters, mission cards, stratagems/detachments/factions, leader pairings). Run `npm install` then `node extract.mjs` to refresh 40k/data/40kdc/, and the generate-*.mjs scripts to regenerate game data.

scripts.codex11e: node wahapedia-import.mjs --faction adeptus-custodes --report ../../.llm/codex_11e_wahapedia/import_report_custodes.md && node wahapedia-import.mjs --faction orks --report ../../.llm/codex_11e_wahapedia/import_report_orks.md && node curate-from-wahapedia.mjs --faction adeptus-custodes && node generate-stratagems.mjs --only-faction AC && node generate-stratagems.mjs --only-faction ORK && node generate-leader-pairings.mjs --only-faction adeptus-custodes && node generate-leader-pairings.mjs --only-faction orks && node gen_codex_builder_patch.mjs && python3 -I gen_custodes_builder_patch.py && python3 -I gen_orks_builder_patch.py
